items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: guys that were supposed to be famous in those days, Joe Brooks and Rene Baptiste. And those people, when I played the number I found so many changes in between what they played

ctx.x: Bill Morero was in the Superior. Yes, he was.
He was playing bass with the Superior. And Willie Santiago, I think Joe Brooks, Joe Brooks was playing with Olympia, too.

items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Captain Joe sent a telegram up there and says, well you go out to Huntless Music Store and pick out any kind of horn you want.

ctx.x: So he met me at the boat on a rehearsal morning and he said, Pops, I don't believe I can make it. And I said, why? He said, well, I always say if I go on the boat he's going to take my horn. I said, don't worry about the horn, you want to make the trip? I said, you get a horn. He said, yeah, I'd like to make it. I said, will you come on the boat? I said, we'll talk to the captain after rehearsal. So I told Faye about it. He said, you don't have to worry about the horn. He said, Captain will buy him any kind of…
That story got a lot of old rag and horn and music music. Yes indeed.
